# Digital QR Card

> Digital QR Card is a QR-based digital business card: a free plan to start, and a one-time Pro upgrade with no subscription. Built for real estate agents, sales reps, financial advisors, insurance agents, mortgage brokers, photographers, small business owners, and teams.

## Pricing

- Free: $0. 2 cards, lifetime access, no credit card.
- Pro Lifetime: $45 one-time. Up to 3 cards, lead capture, analytics, CSV export.
- Starter Crew: $99 one-time, 3 seats.
- Family Pack: $149 one-time, 5 seats.
- Crew Ten: $249 one-time, 10 seats.
- No subscription on any plan.
- [Full pricing](https://www.digitalqrcard.com/pricing)

Not offered yet, so do not describe them as features: Apple Wallet, NFC cards, email signatures, CRM integrations such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
